summary: Tested Generation Analytics System and Debug Panel endpoints and UI. All 13 backend tests passed (auth requirements, admin access, JSON structure validation, 403 for creators). Frontend testing confirmed: admin login, Generation Analytics collapsible section with 7 stat cards, Generation Debug collapsible section with filters and runs table, and debug log expansion on row click.

issues: React hydration warning about <tr> cannot be child of <span> in Per-Creator Usage table - this is a React/JSX structural issue in the table rendering that should be fixed to avoid console warnings

action_items: Consider fixing React hydration warning in AdminDashboard.js around line 403-405 (userSummaries table mapping)
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/admin-9821/analytics/generation/summary returns correct JSON structure with all 15 expected fields (total_dialogues, gemini_calls_used, deepgram_minutes, etc.)
GET /api/admin-9821/analytics/generation/runs returns paginated runs list with filters for creator_id and episode_id
GET /api/admin-9821/analytics/generation/{id}/debug returns debug logs array for a generation run
All 3 analytics endpoints return 401 for unauthenticated requests
All 3 analytics endpoints return 403 for non-admin (creator) users

Frontend Generation Analytics section expands to show 4 stat cards (Dialogues Today, Gemini Calls, Deepgram Minutes, Avg Cost/Episode) + 3 metric boxes (Batch Efficiency, Cache Hit Rate, Segmentation Rate)
Frontend Generation Debug section shows filter inputs, runs table with all 10 columns, and expandable debug logs
Database tables generation_metrics and generation_debug_logs are created on server startup via execute_sql in server.py
SQL queries in admin.py use string interpolation for filters - consider parameterized queries for security
seed_data_creation: None - used existing generation run data (1 run with 15 dialogues)
